verdict.rationale: Brevo documents its own MCP integration, which lets AI models act on a Brevo account and manage campaigns and contacts from ChatGPT or Claude. It also documents filter-based segments built on demographics, website activity, engagement and custom events. However, nothing shows segments being created through the API or MCP, so an agent turning a plain-language description into a saved segment is only implied. Aura AI answers plain-language questions about data, but it is not shown creating segments. Missing for 10: a documented segment-creation endpoint or MCP tool, evidence that filter criteria can be expressed programmatically, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of an agent creating a segment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can translate a plain-language audience description into a real segment via the platform's programmatic surface

citations.quote: Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
Search, save, and manage contacts with filters like demographics, website activity, campaign engagement, and custom events. Create as many segments as you need.
Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
